data.title: Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club
data.about:
Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club is a prestigious equestrian community in the heart of DubaiLand, offering an unparalleled blend of luxury and the elite sport of polo. Spanning an impressive 6 million square feet, this meticulously designed development features four international-standard polo fields, a state-of-the-art riding school, and 500 stables. Al Habtoor Polo Resort comprises 147 exquisitely crafted villas, including 3 to 6-bedroom semi-detached and standalone residences, each offering  breathtaking views of lush landscapes and top-tier polo facilities. 

Beyond its world-class residences, Al Habtoor Polo Resort, Dubai also boasts a 151-key luxury Andalusian-style hotel and 25 resort-branded homes, making it a distinctive destination for discerning investors and equestrian enthusiasts alike. With its prime location, this one-of-a-kind development offers an unparalleled blend of convenience, prestige, and an elite sporting lifestyle.

characteristics_module.title: Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club: An Elite Enclave for Equestrian Enthusiasts
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Dubai’s Ultimate Equestrian Retreat – A prestigious development crafted for equestrian aficionados, boasting four world-class polo fields, a premier riding school, and 500 cutting-edge stables.
  • Opulent Villa Collection – Explore 3 to 6-bedroom semi-detached and standalone residences, offering expansive layouts, elegant finishes, and panoramic views of lush polo landscapes.
  • Expansive 6 Million Sq. Ft. Community – A meticulously designed, nature-infused enclave dedicated to equestrian living, seamlessly blending luxury, tranquility, and top-tier amenities.
  • Resort-Inspired Luxury Living – Featuring a 151-key Andalusian-style five-star hotel and 25 resort-branded villas, offering an unparalleled hospitality-infused residential experience.
  • Unmatched Connectivity – Nestled in DubaiLand, just 24 minutes from Dubai Mall and 25 minutes from Dubai International Airport, ensuring effortless access to the city's key hubs.
  • A Masterpiece by Al Habtoor Group – Developed by a legacy brand synonymous with excellence since 1970, renowned for delivering prestigious properties locally and internationally.
  • An Exclusive Lifestyle & Thriving Community – Join a sophisticated network of equestrian enthusiasts, indulging in private club access, fine dining, and elite social gatherings.
  • A Prime Investment Opportunity – With a limited selection of luxury homes, a sought-after location, and an esteemed developer, this is a high-value asset with strong appreciation potential.

location_tile.title: Experience the Pinnacle of Leisure Living in the Heart of DubaiLand
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Nestled in the heart of DubaiLand, Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club offers a serene escape while remaining well-connected to the city’s key destinations. DubaiLand is a rapidly evolving district known for its expansive landscapes, luxury communities, and world-class leisure attractions. With seamless access to Dubai Mall, Mall of the Emirates, and Dubai International Airport, residents enjoy the perfect blend of exclusivity and convenience. The area is home to some of Dubai’s most prestigious developments, making it an ideal destination for those seeking a refined lifestyle surrounded by nature and top-tier amenities.

  • 20 minutes – Global Village
  • 22 minutes – Dubai Hills Mall
  • 24 minutes – Dubai Mall
  • 25 minutes – Mall of the Emirates
  • 25 minutes – Dubai International Airport
  • 30 minutes – Burj Al Arab

seo.metaDescription: Discover luxury living at Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club, offering 3-6 bedroom semi-detached & standalone villas in DubaiLand with world-class equestrian facilities.

more_info.answer: The community offers exclusive villas ranging from 3 to 6 bedrooms, including semi-detached and standalone villas, as well as 25 resort-branded homes designed for those who appreciate equestrian living.
more_info.question: What types of properties are available at Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club?

more_info.answer: Residents have access to four international-standard polo fields, a riding school, dressage and showjumping arenas, and over 500 stables, providing the best environment for horse enthusiasts.
more_info.question: What equestrian facilities are available in the community?

more_info.answer:
3-bedroom semi-detached villas start at AED 4.7M
4-bedroom semi-detached villas start at AED 6M
4-bedroom standalone villas start at AED 12M
5-bedroom standalone villas start at AED 14M
6-bedroom villas start at AED 26M
more_info.question: What are the starting prices for villas in the community?

more_info.answer: Residents can enjoy fine dining restaurants, a luxury spa, a fitness center, swimming pools, tennis courts, landscaped gardens, and a private members-only polo club. The resort also includes a 151-key Andalusian-style luxury hotel.
